# Published Google Sites fixtures

These five HTML fixtures contain the original academic page content retrieved on
26 September 2026 from `https://sites.google.com/view/guoleizhongshomepage/`.
Google navigation, scripts, CSS classes, and unrelated attributes were removed;
section nesting, main landmarks, titles, inline spans, visible text, hyperlinks,
and image URLs are retained. They exercise the actual Google Sites structure
without bundling its runtime or relying on network access during tests.

The development test also compares against complete original responses in
`work/original-*.html` when those files are available.
